6 Thanks - James Lee Kiser - 6 - in Hyland Park Gen. Hosp. diagnosed as infantile paralysis and again tumor. Operation was to take place yesterday. Mother phoned day before when child was on way to hosp- ital. A 2nd Ex-ray showed nothing wrong. Child home and OK. Deo Grat.
7 Thanks - Rita Messer - 23 - given 3 days to live Feb. 19 in Carmel Hosp. friend called to enroll at once .... Is working and in perfect health ... Deo Gr.
